personalHistory.note: Steam Personal Game Data cache. Steam GMT timestamps are normalized to Beijing time (UTC+08:00); detailed matches and map aggregates are rebuilt from the same match rows.

historyAudit.note: Detailed matches, history summary and map aggregation reconcile.

dataQuality.note: Official cumulative and weapon data use Steam Web API/cache. Detailed history merges Steam Personal Game Data with Perfect World Arena and Perfect-visible official records; matching cross-source official games are de-duplicated and enriched before map/summary audit.

matchSource.steamWebApi: GetUserStatsForGame is used for cumulative and weapon stats, with local cache fallback.
matchSource.personalGameData: Steam Personal Game Data match rows imported from the authenticated local browser session.
matchSource.perfectWorld: Run BIND_CS2_PERFECT.cmd to add Perfect World Arena data.

steam.note: Valve Steam Web API - cached/recovered official cumulative snapshot.

heybox.note: Heybox account connected and its bound SteamID64 matches the bound Steam identity.

personalGameData.note: Steam Personal Game Data cache. Steam GMT timestamps are normalized to Beijing time (UTC+08:00); detailed matches and map aggregates are rebuilt from the same match rows.

perfectWorld.note: Perfect World client-used interface; bind locally with BIND_CS2_PERFECT.cmd.

playnite.note: CS2 total playtime displayed on the record page uses the Playnite exported total.
